newsitem.title: USA: Willbros says it signed $100 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Willbros says it signed $100 mln in contracts.

text.p: Willbros Group Inc said Monday three of its operating units signed letters of intent for contracts totaling more than $100 million in Nigeria, Indonesia and South America.

In an unspecified country in South America, Willbros is to construct about 200 kilometers (120 miles) of 36-inch and 20-inch pipelines. The contractor expects revenues of more than $40 million, according to a statement. Construction is scheduled to begin in the third quarter and completion in the second quarter of 1998.

The company also is to construct about 32 kilometers (20 miles), of a 36-inch pipeline in Nigeria. Willbros expects the project to generate more than $30 million in revenues. It is scheduled to begin in the third quarter and be completed in the second quarter of 1998.

Finally, Willbros is to engineer, procure and construct about 57 kilometers (35 miles) of 42-inch gas pipeline on the island of Kalimantan in Indonesia. The company projects more than $30 million of revenues. Construction is scheduled to begin in the third quarter and completion in the fourth quarter of 1998.
Contract negotiations are currently underway for each of these projects, the company said.

Willbros chief executive, Larry Bump, said in a statement the company was "beginning to experience significant growth in some of (its) newer markets, such as Asia and South America, while activity in Africa continues at a strong pace."
Willbros opened at 13-7/8 on Monday, up 1/8.
